about.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation

body:
## Behavior changes
- `serve`: the `--http-max-concurrent` default now follows `--cdp-max-connections` (8× it, between 40 and 256). With the default 16 connections it is 128.
- `fetch --dump markdown` now asks the server for markdown (`Accept: text/markdown,...`). A `text/markdown` response is dumped as-is. Not sent with `--dump-selector`, `--wait-selector` or `--wait-script`.
- `Accessibility.getPartialAXTree` now honors `fetchRelatives`, as Chrome does: it returns the node and its relatives, no longer the whole subtree. Use `getFullAXTree` or `getChildAXNodes` for a subtree.
- `DOM.querySelector` with no match now returns `nodeId: 0` instead of an error, as Chrome does.
- Touch event handlers (`ontouchstart`, …) are removed from `document` and elements: Lightpanda doesn't emulate a touch device.
- `navigator.sendBeacon` now checks its arguments. Beacons are still not sent unless `--load-resources beacon` is set.
- The HTTP cache database is deleted and rebuilt when its schema version changes.
- `waitForState` now reports a timeout instead of always answering that the page reached the state.
- MCP over HTTP: a request on a session closed with `DELETE` now gets a 404 instead of starting a new session.
- `fetch()` and `new Request()` with a body on GET or HEAD now throw a `TypeError`.
- Scripts inserted from an isolated world (Playwright `setContent`, `appendChild`) now run in the main world.
- Event listeners now run in their own world's context, so Playwright's `focus()` and `selectOption()` fire React's `onFocus`/`onChange`.

## New Web APIs
- `AudioContext` (WAV only)
- Payment Request API: `PaymentRequest`, `PaymentResponse` and their events, behaving like Chrome with no payment app installed
- `NavigateEvent` on `navigation` (`intercept()` is not implemented)
- `PerformanceNavigationTiming` entry for the document
- `document.execCommand`: `insertText`, `delete`, `forwardDelete`, `selectAll`, `insertLineBreak`, and the `styleWithCSS`, `useCSS` and `defaultParagraphSeparator` settings. Other commands return `false`
- `image.decode()`
- `HTMLElement.isContentEditable` (real value), `HTMLElement.spellcheck`, `document.designMode`
- `Touch` constructor and `TouchEvent` touch lists
- `elementFromPoint`/`elementsFromPoint` on `ShadowRoot`
- SVG `getBBox()`
- `HTMLFrameElement`, `SecurityPolicyViolationEvent`, a stub `Path2D`
- `navigator.mimeTypes` (empty `MimeTypeArray`)
- `img.sizes`; `link.relList.supports()` for `dns-prefetch`, `preconnect` and `prefetch`
- `HTMLFieldSetElement.elements`; `abbr`, `mark`, `small`, `wbr` and other HTMLElement-only tags are now `HTMLElement` instead of `HTMLUnknownElement`
- `onmouseenter` and `onmouseleave` handlers
- Web Crypto: `raw-secret` and `raw-public` key formats; `CryptoKey` is now serializable (`structuredClone`, `postMessage`, IndexedDB)
- `MessagePort` is now transferable
- `TextDecoderStream` decodes every encoding `TextDecoder` supports, with state kept across chunks
- `XMLSerializer` now writes XML instead of HTML
- WebMCP follows the current spec: `document.modelContext`, `getTools()`, `toolchange`, `registerTool` returns a promise
- CSS: native nesting, color parsing, more known properties (`CSS.supports`, unknown property errors)

## Web API behavior / fixes
- Layout: flex-shrink, horizontal margins, `left`/`right`/`inset`, and widths from text measurement. Widths are relative to the containing box. Out-of-flow children no longer size their parent, and block boxes start at their parent's left edge
- `position` is now read from stylesheets, not only from the inline style (`offsetParent`, `getComputedStyle`)
- An iframe without size is now 300×150, and its box is the frame's viewport, so Playwright can click inside it
- `Range.getClientRects()` now returns one rect per selected element or text node
- `elementFromPoint` returns `null` outside the viewport
- Textarea `scrollHeight` now counts its text, for auto-sizing textareas
- Typing and `Input.insertText` now insert text into `contenteditable` elements and `designMode` documents; Ctrl-A selects all
- Selectors: `:in-range`/`:out-of-range`, `:default`, `:scope` on a document; `:required`/`:optional` only on form controls; `[attr^=""]`, `[attr$=""]` and `[attr*=""]` match nothing
- Forms: `stepMismatch`, Chrome-like `type=email` validation (with `multiple`), `readonly` fields skip validation, empty `action` means the document's URL
- `margin`, `padding`, `inset` and `border-*` shorthands now expand into longhands
- `style.x = null` and `setProperty(name, null)` now remove the declaration
- Media queries accept fractional lengths (`max-width: 767.98px`)
- Changing a `<style>`'s text now clears the style cache
- Un-rendered light DOM (slot fallback with assigned content, unslotted children) is now treated as hidden
- A closed `<details>` keeps its loose text out of `innerText`
- `<a>` and `<area>` URL setters keep userinfo and reject invalid values; better URL port handling
- `navigation.navigate()` with a fragment now updates `location` and the entry URL
- `dataset` rejects invalid names and maps a leading capital to `data--`
- `isEqualNode` compares namespace URIs
- `DOMTokenList.forEach` sees mutations made by its callback
- `select`/`selectionchange` events are now dispatched asynchronously; `eventPhase` is `AT_TARGET` in direct dispatch
- `<dialog>`: `show()` on an open dialog does nothing, `close` fires asynchronously
- `xhr.responseType = 'document'` now parses HTML into an `HTMLDocument`
- `innerHTML = ""` on an `<html>` element creates `<head>` and `<body>`
- `document.fonts.load()` no longer fires load events when there are no font faces
- `navigator.appVersion` now starts with `5.0`
- Properties moved to the right interfaces (e.g. `title` on `Document`); the global's prototype is now `Window.prototype`
- `new WebSocket(url, ['a', 'a'])` throws a `SyntaxError`
- A string longer than V8 accepts throws a `RangeError` instead of aborting
- `import()` of a module that threw rejects with the module's exception
- Inline scripts report errors at their position in the document
- Timers run on the initial `about:blank` page
- Pending timer cap raised from 8192 to 65536

## Scripts
- The parser runs microtasks before preparing a `<script>`, so a `MutationObserver` can change its type first
- Dynamic scripts with `async=false` run in order; dynamic scripts can't be `defer`; inline modules run like external ones
- Already-fetched async scripts now run from a task, after the markup that follows them
- `<script src="">` fires `error` instead of fetching the page

## Cookies / HTTP
- A non-secure origin can't set or overwrite a `Secure` cookie (RFC 6265bis)
- The cookie jar evicts old cookies past Chrome's limits instead of failing the response
- A cookie with neither a name nor a value is ignored; IP addresses are each their own site
- The HTTP cache skips `Range` requests and URLs with userinfo; `Vary` matching fixed
- `--http-cache-set-cookie=skip|store|strip` added (experimental, `store` and `strip` need `--experimental-features`)
- DNS lookups are shared across connections
- The robots.txt cache now expires after 24 hours
- Web Bot Auth: `Signature-Agent` is the quoted origin, and each signed request has a nonce

## CDP
- File downloads (`Browser.setDownloadBehavior`), saved to disk or streamed
- Accessibility domain completed: `getRootAXNode`, `getAXNodeAndAncestors`, `getChildAXNodes`; shadow DOM is now walked in the AX tree
- `Page.setDocumentContent` (Puppeteer `page.setContent()`)
- `Performance.getMetrics` (`Timestamp`, `JSHeapUsedSize`, `JSHeapTotalSize`)
- `Input.setInterceptDrags` and `Input.dispatchDragEvent`
- `CSS.getComputedStyleForNode`
- `DOM.getContentQuads` and `DOM.getBoxModel` for text nodes
- `Page.navigateToHistoryEntry` restores a same-document entry in place
- `Fetch.fulfillRequest` now stores the response's cookies
- `Network.loadingFinished.encodedDataLength` now reports the bytes received
- An unknown context returns Chrome's error code and message
- `/json/protocol` updated

## Tools / MCP
- `download` tool, streamed to disk
- `pageTools` and `callPageTool`: list and call the page's WebMCP tools
- `classify`, `acceptCookies` and `login` tools (TypeSafe Jev with `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`)
- MCP `run` tool: run a PandaScript by source or by path
- MCP stdio: `notifications/cancelled` stops the in-flight tool call
- `tree`: ARIA `checked` and `expanded` states
- `interactiveElements` reports whether an element is in a fixed or sticky overlay
- Structured data: microdata
- A missing required argument is now named in the error; `null` means unset
- A `backendNodeId` whose node left the document is rejected
- Markdown: empty code spans dropped, no inline markup inside code
- Redacted dumps keep an empty password field empty

## Agent
- xAI (Grok) provider, `XAI_API_KEY`
- LLMD provider and Parallel search (`PARALLEL_API_KEY`)
- REPL tool commands take a prompt (`/click the add to cart button`), recorded with explicit selectors for `/save`
- The REPL exits when its terminal goes away
- Ctrl-C and timeouts now stop a script that loops after an `await`

## WebDriver
- `POST /session/{id}/window`

## Performance / stability
- Compiled scripts (classic and modules) are stored in the HTTP cache
- Single-threaded arena allocator (~10% faster on WPT)
- Faster V8 ↔ Zig calls (~10%)
- Faster style matching, selector lists, class and sibling selectors, `getTag()`
- Inline transforms no longer drop the cascade's memos
- Cookie jar stored per site
- Arenas free blocks they can't keep instead of keeping them in place
- Response bodies are no longer buffered in the transfer's arena
- Faster startup on macOS
- Crash and UAF fixes: `call_arena` in nested calls, EventSource double abort, `document.write`, structured-cloned `FileList`, `DataCloneError` messages, WebMCP tool errors, stale tool registry nodes

## Security
- brotli updated to 1.2.1

## Build
- Nix package and dev shell
